next_steps: Approve or reject payment request #1 ($2,400.00 to Elm City Properties) on the dashboard before 2026-09-02.
Once you approve it, Accounting runs pay(1). Checking then drops from $3,400.00 to $1,000.00, and the ticket can be marked resolved.
Review draft 1 to Elm City Properties and send it yourself if it's right. Nothing has been sent.
After rent is paid, only $1,000.00 is left for vendor bills and restocks, and no money comes in. Check any new payment requests against that balance before approving them.
